definition: Six corner edges per TETRA10 and twelve standard perimeter edges per eight-slot BRICK; degenerate self-edges discarded, duplicates removed, both directions retained.
coupling_limitation: This graph contains physical element edges only. TYPE2 tied interfaces and contact/rigid-wall interactions between disjoint parts do not add edges. Dataset globals and FEM labels still include those interactions; graph connectivity alone does not encode them.
coverage: Every solid-referenced ANIM/VTK corner node is covered. Original quadratic midside nodes omitted by ANIM connectivity are not claimed as predicted nodes.
